description: Image findings that are known, have no fix to take, and have no OpenVEX statement because no justification is true of them. The daily vulnerability report compares this list and the OpenVEX document with a scan of the published image; docs/verifying.md lists the same CVEs for readers.

findings.reason: A weaker exploit mitigation in glibc itself, not a code path that can be shown absent or unreached. glibc upstream does not treat it as a security bug and has released no fix.
